Calculate marginal model likelihood using independent normal approximations

Source: R/mcmc.R
model.loglik.indep.Rd

Computes the marginal log-likelihood (model evidence) for MCMC samples using importance sampling based on independent normal distributions for each parameter.

Usage

model.loglik.indep(
  loglik,
  logprior,
  response,
  covariate,
  hyperparam,
  param.template,
  samples,
  num.iterations
)

Arguments

loglik

Function to calculate log-likelihood.

logprior

Function to calculate log-prior.

response

Numeric vector of response data.

covariate

Covariate data or additional predictors.

hyperparam

Hyper-parameters used in the prior.

param.template

Template object giving an indication of how the parameter vector should look like.

samples

Matrix or data.frame of MCMC posterior parameter samples (parameters in rows, samples in columns).

num.iterations

Integer. Number of importance sampling iterations.

Value

Numeric value representing the estimated marginal log-likelihood (log evidence).
